features.name: Personnel Data Entry
features.plain_english: This is where HR staff fill in a multi-section form capturing an employee's personal details, current position, and the position they are being evaluated for promotion to.

features.name: Work Evaluation & Scoring
features.plain_english: This is where past work achievements, performance scores, evaluation dates, and structured evaluation grids (eval51_rows, eval52_rows) are recorded for each candidate.

features.name: Records CRUD API
features.plain_english: This is the server-side logic that creates, reads, updates, and deletes promotion records, including validation of required Thai-language fields.

features.name: PDF Attachment Management
features.plain_english: This is where PDF documents (announcement letters, supporting documents) are uploaded, stored as UUID-named files on disk, previewed, and downloaded.

features.name: Summary Dashboard
features.plain_english: This is where statistics are shown — total candidates, pass/fail counts by result and position level — rendered as charts using Chart.js.

features.name: Records List & Search
features.plain_english: This is the searchable table view listing all submitted promotion records so HR staff can quickly find, edit, or delete an entry.

features.name: CSV Export
features.plain_english: This lets HR staff download all records as a CSV file for use in Excel or other reporting tools.

features.name: Database & Migrations
features.plain_english: This is the SQLite database that stores all promotion records and attachment metadata, with automatic schema migration handling legacy BLOB columns.

features.name: Infrastructure & Desktop Launcher
features.plain_english: This handles packaging the app as a Windows desktop executable using pywebview and PyInstaller, and configures the Flask server for both dev and frozen modes.

external_services.name: Google Fonts
external_services.purpose: Loads the Sarabun Thai-language typeface for the UI

external_services.name: Bootstrap CDN (cdnjs)
external_services.purpose: Delivers Bootstrap 5 CSS for responsive layout and UI components

external_services.name: Font Awesome CDN
external_services.purpose: Delivers icon glyphs used throughout the interface

external_services.name: Chart.js CDN
external_services.purpose: Renders bar and summary charts on the dashboard tab
